paragraphs: Geviah bar Kosem; Bereshit Rabbah 61:7. Hyman’s “our reading” in Sanhedrin 91a is Geviha ben Pesisa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Geviah bar Kosem and Geviha ben Pesisa are the different readings attributed to Bereshit Rabbah and the current Sanhedrin text.

The whole Torat Emet digital Bereshit Rabbah 61:7 paragraph has Geviah ben Kosem, whereas Hyman supplies bar Kosem. The whole Davidson Sanhedrin 91a paragraphs name Geviha ben Pesisa. The ben/bar and spelling differences remain distinct; Hyman’s comparison does not create an identity binding or establish a printed correction history.
